projects.title: A Custom-Built List Tool, $210K Pipeline in 3 Months
projects.oneLineResult: Built a custom list-building tool before modern enrichment platforms existed, driving a $210K pipeline for a Shopify SEO agency in three months.
projects.problem: Logeix needed a reliable, repeatable way to book meetings and sign new clients for its Shopify SEO service. This was a productized offer, not a general retainer, so outreach needed to speak directly to a specific, well-defined type of prospect. At the time, there were no data enrichment tools like Clay, so list building had to be done manually or with custom tooling.
projects.solution: Built a custom Chrome extension to scrape prospect lists, since no enrichment platforms existed yet for this. Used Google's site search syntax (site:example.com collections) to find Shopify stores, since every Shopify store uses "/collections/" in its category page URLs — this pulled large lists of Shopify stores directly from search results. Filtered the list down to stores based in North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand with more than 2,000 monthly visits, since that traffic level signaled an active store already investing in growth. For personalization, researched each prospect's niche competitors and ran a keyword gap analysis, looking for navigational or transactional keywords with more than 100 monthly searches that the competitor ranked for but the prospect did not — then used this directly in outreach copy, naming the competitor, the specific keyword gap, and the estimated upside.
projects.result: 70% open rate and 7-8% reply rate, at a time when open rate tracking still worked reliably before ESP providers began penalizing it. Booked multiple meetings and signed 3 clients over 3 months, each with a lifetime value of approximately $20,000, for $60,000 in closed revenue. An additional $150,000 in active leads sat in the CRM at the time, bringing total pipeline generated to approximately $210,000.

projects.title: $33K in Pipeline for a UGC and Performance Marketing Agency
projects.industry: UGC and performance marketing agency, United States
projects.oneLineResult: Built a 15-domain cold email and LinkedIn outreach engine for a UGC and performance marketing agency, generating $33K in pipeline in a single month.
projects.problem: Viral Fire connects ecommerce brands with a combination of UGC content and performance marketing services. The goal was to reach ecommerce store owners and show them how quality video content could drive more sales, with no existing outbound engine in place.
projects.solution: Worked with the company CEO to source ecommerce store data from LeadFuze, UpLead, BuiltWith, and StoreLeads. Found and verified contact details for multiple C-level executives and managers at each target company using GetProspect, Apollo, and Snov, since sourcing accurate emails and LinkedIn profiles was the main early challenge. Built separate ICPs based on each store's ecommerce vertical and monthly revenue. Purchased 15 domains and set up G Suite accounts with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records, then warmed them up for deliverability, with custom domain tracking set up across all 15 domains. Ran a multi-sequence cold email campaign with follow-ups branching based on each prospect's initial response, alongside parallel LinkedIn outreach.
projects.result: Sent 50,000 emails including follow-ups, with a 60% open rate and 3% response rate. Generated 43 positive replies and booked 11 meetings, for approximately $33,000 in pipeline. Some of this pipeline converted to closed clients, but the exact count and value are unconfirmed.
